# Grain Hub Australia

> Grain Hub Australia is a Melbourne-based exporter of premium, non-GMO Australian pulses, lentils and grains, exporting farm-direct to global markets since 2016.

## Products

- [Lentils](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/lentils)
- [Kabuli Chickpeas](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/kabuli-chickpeas)
- [Desi Chickpeas](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/desi-chickpeas)
- [Mung Beans](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/mung-beans)
- [Yellow Split Peas](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/yellow-split-peas)
- [Kaspa Peas](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/kaspa-peas)
- [Wheat Grain](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/wheat-grain)
- [Red Sorghum](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/red-sorghum)
- [Faba Beans](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/faba-beans)
- [Barley](https://grainhubaustralia.com.au/products/barley)
